'''Dongal Tezrin''' was the [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Captain/Legends|captain]] of the [[Bayonet-class light cruiser|''Bayonet''-class light cruiser]] ''[[Rintonne's Flame]]''. He was assigned to patrol the [[Elrood sector/Legends|Elrood sector]] during the [[Rebellion era]]. He was said to be a very irritable person.
